'''Viktor Anatolievich Matveev''' ({{langx|ru|Ви́ктор Анато́льевич Матве́ев}}; 11 December 1941) is a Russian [[physicist|theoretical physicist]], director of the [[Joint Institute for Nuclear Research]] (2012-2020) and member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] who has made fundamental contributions to areas of [[Particle physics]], [[Theoretical Physics]] [[Mathematical Physics]], [[Quantum field theory]] and [[High energy physics]].<ref name="auto"/>
